expectedBehavior: Marking an Epic acceptance criterion as verified should complete promptly without blocking the main UI thread or causing the app to beachball.
notes: Performance issue reported from interactive use on 2026-07-07.
Likely investigation areas include synchronous persistence, canonical projection/export work, GitHub/backend refresh work, or main-thread state recomputation triggered by AC verification.

Implemented on 2026-07-07. Evidence: `xcodebuild test -project AgileCockpit/AgileCockpit.xcodeproj -scheme AgileCockpit -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:AgileCockpitTests` passed. The fix avoids a full dashboard reload after Epic AC verification and suppresses the self-triggered file watcher refresh from the canonical save.
observedBehavior: On the Sprint & Epic Detail View, Epic Criteria tab, marking an acceptance criterion as verified takes many seconds, roughly 30 seconds per verification, and the app shows the spinning beachball during the operation.
reproductionSteps: Open the Sprint & Epic Detail View.
Select an Epic and open the Epic Criteria tab.
Mark an acceptance criterion as verified.
Observe that the operation takes roughly 30 seconds and the app beachballs before completing.

workItem.title: Epic criteria verification freezes detail view
